answer: Average reputation is where sybils launder. Standing is a mesa built in strata, one layer per epoch carrying that period's verified quality - never re-scored, rebased, or hidden. A recent plume of clean activity cannot cover a cracked foundation: every stratum stays inspectable. Newcomers and clones start with thin, reef-soft mesas needing seasons of deposition before their column means anything; fraud's shortcuts - buying identities, rewriting history - hit the one thing strata forbid: editing the past. Erosion is honest; only the present can fail, yet the whole column testifies.
